top_signals.summary: Countries outside the Gulf increase market share of urea exports as supplies through Strait of Hormuz collapse
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ten-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007
top_signals.summary: Benchmark bond yield rises to 5.04% and stocks fall amid concerns over inflation and higher interest rates
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Tata Sons’ Listed Shareholders Rally After RBI Renews IPO Push
top_signals.summary: Tata Group companies with minority ownership of Tata Sons Pvt. jumped, bucking a broader market decline, following Indian banking regulator’s refusal to exempt the conglomerate’s holding entity from a rule that requires it to go for a public listing.
